import cv2,numpy as np
im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png').astype(np.float32)
h,w=im.shape[:2]
Y,X=np.mgrid[:h,:w]
# source is 260 left; use destination shifted left
src=cv2.remap(im,(X-260).astype(np.float32),Y.astype(np.float32),cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
# elliptical mask centered 440,300, broad
q=((X-440)/135)**2+((Y-300)/78)**2
mask=np.clip((1.15-q)/.35,0,1)
mask=cv2.GaussianBlur(mask.astype(np.float32),(0,0),7)[...,None]
out=im*(1-mask)+src*mask
cv2.imwrite('.tmp/blend_out.png',np.uint8(out))
cv2.imwrite('.tmp/blend_crop.png',np.uint8(out)[180:390,280:650])
